messages:
sam: quick follow-up on the query-circuit-breaker RFC. we hit a case in staging where console dashboards cascade when sidecar starts 503ing.
maya: can you paste the logs / timeline?
sam: hitting 503s from query-sidecar for ~90s, dashboard panels started queuing, then authz checks piled up and made things worse.
jiang: is this the same as earlier RBAC gating vs query split? my concern: moving CB to edge will bypass authz checks and cause stale 200s.
sam: proposal: keep RBAC at control plane but move circuit-breaker to the ingress proxy (edge) so we can fail fast per-tenant instead of per-panel.
lina: tradeoff: edge-level CB loses per-route visibility (model vs query). we might misclassify soft errors as hard and hide useful retries.
ben: option B: implement two-tier CB: edge short-circuit for latency + per-route CB for correctness. edge returns 429 with Retry-After, per-route returns fallback route where appropriate.
maya: perf wins for edge short-circuit are significant: median->95th token latency drops ~30% in perf tests when we short-circuit earlier.
sam: but RBAC interplay: if edge returns 429 before authz, logs will show 429 without tenant id. need to preserve tenant header extraction and audit fields.
jiang: we can extract tenant from mTLS subject or SNI at edge and attach X-Tenant for internal routing. sec team ok with extraction if we preserve signature and audit trail.
eng-security-bot: sec-check: extracting tenant at edge is allowed if we preserve auth headers and write an audit heartbeat. PII logging risk flagged; redact in logs.
lina: also we need to record which authz version was used. fallback route decisions must be audited for compliance.
sam: action items:
- add edge CB prototype that reads X-Tenant and preserves auth headers
- implement per-route CB policy for model/query routes
- update console to treat 429 as soft-degrade and surface panel-level "no-data" with a link to docs
maya: i'll run a perf run on edge CB this afternoon and post numbers. toggling behind feature-flag: console.query.edge_cb
ben: i'll draft a migration checklist for Dedicated customers (they'll want stricter CB settings + opt-outs).
sam: thanks. if no objections i'll convert this into a follow-up RFC and timeline by EOD.
lina: +1
sam: deploy-bot: created task infra#4523
deploy-bot: Task infra#4523 created by sam. status: open.
sam: closing loop for now.
